import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # numbers stored as text -> numeric
    for c in ["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "year"]:
        d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(",", ""), errors="coerce")
    # negative flipper lengths are sign errors -> absolute value
    d["flipper_length_mm"] = d["flipper_length_mm"].abs()
    # body mass magnitude/unit errors (e.g. 5050000 g) -> rescale into valid range
    def fix_mass(v):
        if pd.isna(v):
            return v
        while v > 6500 and v % 10 == 0:
            v = v / 10.0
        if v < 2500:
            while v < 2500:
                v = v * 10.0
        return v
    d["body_mass_g"] = d["body_mass_g"].apply(fix_mass)
    # clip/normalize other numeric ranges
    d["bill_length_mm"] = d["bill_length_mm"].where(d["bill_length_mm"].between(30, 60), np.nan)
    d["flipper_length_mm"] = d["flipper_length_mm"].where(d["flipper_length_mm"].between(170, 235), np.nan)
    d["body_mass_g"] = d["body_mass_g"].where(d["body_mass_g"].between(2500, 6500), np.nan)
    # sex label variants (whitespace/case) -> canonical; missing stays missing
    s = d["sex"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    s = s.where(s.isin(["male", "female"]), np.nan)
    d["sex"] = s
    # species label normalization
    d["species"] = d["species"].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize()
    d["species"] = d["species"].where(d["species"].isin(["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]), np.nan)
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["species", "body_mass_g"])
    g = d.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
